0.body:
RIFTBOUND MOD TTS OGY - quick start

1. Sit down: press 'Sit here' on the control strip at your side of the table.
2. Host: on the TABLE console (corner), pick the mode (1v1 / 2v2 / FFA 3 / FFA 4). Table images are built in; you can paste links to your own card back or mats there if you like.
3. Everyone: paste your Piltover Archive deck code into your strip, press Import. Legend, champion, runes, battlefields and sideboard go to their places automatically. Your champion copies go to your hand: drag one onto the Champion slot; the rest go back into the deck at game start.
4. Host: Start game (Random or a colour).
5. Mulligan: drag up to 2 cards from your hand back onto your Main Deck, press Mulligan done. You draw the same number; the cards you put back go to the bottom.
6. Turns run automatically. Press End turn on your strip (or TTS's own turn button).

Supply (table side / corners): marker and dice piles (grab one, a new one appears), and the token card selector (click < > to pick Recruit, Sprite, Gold..., then drag it out).

Right-click a card: Reveal to everyone, Buff, Damage, To trash, Recycle, Banish, Return to hand.
Chat: !rb help

Found a bug? Press 'Report a bug' on the host console or type !rb bug in chat.

Card data: Riot's official card gallery (playriftbound.com), Riftcodex as fallback. Riftbound Mod TTS Ogy was created under Riot Games' "Legal Jibber Jabber" policy using assets owned by Riot Games. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project.
